---
title: "Start here"
subtitle: "Before Day 1"
---

## 1. Take the entry check {#entry-check}

A 15-minute self-assessment with three questions in each of four areas: probability, linear
algebra and calculus, PyTorch, and Python with NumPy. If you miss two or more questions in an
area, the check links to specific free reading for that area.

::: {.callout-note}
The entry check is not published yet. Until it is, go on to step 2.
:::

## 2. Set up one run path {#setup}

Google Colab is the default and needs only a Google account. You can also run the labs on
your own machine or on an AWS GPU instance. See [Setup](/setup.qmd).

## 3. Run Module 0 {#module-0}

[Module 0 · Setup and hello RL](/modules/00-setup.qmd) checks your environment, measures how
fast it is, and runs a random agent on CartPole. It takes about 20 minutes.

## 4. Start with Module 1 {#module-1}

[Module 1 · MDPs, returns and the Bellman equation](/modules/01-mdps-bellman.qmd) opens Day 1.
